operation_details.item: The R&D budget share was originally set at 40%.

conversation.speaker: ai_agent
conversation.message: How is the budget planning coming along?

conversation.speaker: user_agent
conversation.message: The R&D budget share was originally set at 40%, but we’ve revised it to 35%.

conversation.speaker: user_agent
conversation.message: We reallocated the difference to support the go-to-market plan.

conversation.speaker: ai_agent
conversation.message: Has the revised allocation been finalized?

conversation.speaker: user_agent
conversation.message: Yes, the new allocation is approved in the budget system.

conversation.speaker: ai_agent
conversation.message: That should make the planning numbers easier to use going forward.

conversation.speaker: user_agent
conversation.message: Exactly—the current 35% allocation and the rationale are now reflected in the plan.

conversation.speaker: user_agent
conversation.message: Please forget only the original 40% R&D share and retain the current 35% allocation and rationale.
